data.subject: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Joint Venture Agreements
data.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved a Joint Venture Agreement with Toyokawa Techno Private Limited to manufacture Thin-Film Transistor Display Modules. The Board also proposed the voluntary strike-off of subsidiary Kaynes Embedded Systems Private Limited, subject to statutory formalities. The auditor's review noted restatements for prior period errors. The consolidated results include a share of net loss from associate Mixx Technologies, Inc. of Rs. 60.02 million for the quarter and Rs. 104.40 million for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026. The auditor could not comment on adjustments related to the associate due to lack of reviewed financials. The meeting concluded at 21:30 IST on November 14, 2026.

data.subject: Kaynes Technology India Limited (Company) has informed the Exchange about execution of binding term sheet amongst the Company, Kaynes Semicon Private Limited, the wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. and Ecomal Nederland B.V.
data.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited executed a binding term sheet on November 12, 2026, with Vishay Intertechnology Inc., its subsidiary Ecomal Nederland B.V., and its wholly owned subsidiary Kaynes Semicon Private Limited. The agreement establishes a joint venture through Kaynes Semicon Private Limited to provide semiconductor back-end manufacturing services, including post-fab wafer processing, assembly, test, and packaging. Vishay will acquire a 49% stake in the subsidiary. Mr. Raghu Panicker will serve as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the subsidiary. The transaction is subject to finalization of terms, execution of definitive agreements, required approvals, and customary closing conditions.

data.subject: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended 30 September 2026
data.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited filed Monitoring Agency Reports for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the utilization of proceeds from two Qualified Institutional Placements. The first QIP was allotted on December 21, 2023, with ICRA Limited as the monitoring agency. The second QIP was allotted on June 24, 2025, with CRISIL Ratings Limited as the monitoring agency. ICRA reported no material deviation in the utilization of proceeds for the December 2023 issue, which raised INR 1374.000 Crore. Funds were utilized for the OSAT Facility, PCB Facility, and general corporate purposes. The PCB Facility was completed in March 2026, and general corporate purposes were completed in June 2025. The OSAT Facility is on schedule for FY24 to FY27. CRISIL Ratings Limited submitted a similar report for the June 2025 issue.

data.subject: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
data.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited has announced an earnings conference call for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2026-27. The call is scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 08:30 A.M. Indian Standard Time. Key participants include Chairperson Mrs Savitha Ramesh, Executive Vice Chairman Mr Ramesh Kannan, Managing Director Dr Muthukumar Narayanaswamy, Whole-time Director and Chief Financial Officer Mr Jairam P Sampath, and Investor Relations representative Mr Sumit Verma. The event is organized in association with MUFG as the Investor Relations Partner. Dial-in numbers for universal access and international toll-free lines are provided for registration. The intimation has been filed with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Details are also available on the company website at www.kaynestechnology.co.in.
